<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <!-- ============================================ -->
    <!-- HUD ELEMENTS - LANDSCAPE OVERRIDES -->
    <!-- ============================================ -->
    <!-- These override the portrait values in values/dimens.xml -->
    
    <!-- Maneuver container -->
    <dimen name="hud_maneuver_margin_start_landscape">16dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_maneuver_margin_end_landscape">8dp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Car stats overlay -->
    <dimen name="hud_car_stats_margin_start_landscape">16dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_car_stats_margin_top_landscape">120dp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Bottom HUD row -->
    <dimen name="hud_bottom_row_margin_start_landscape">16dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_bottom_row_margin_bottom_landscape">25dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_bottom_row_padding_end_landscape">12dp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Trip progress pills -->
    <dimen name="hud_trip_padding_h_landscape">6dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_padding_v_landscape">4dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_separator_margin_h_landscape">6dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_value_min_width_landscape">44dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_value_text_size_landscape">15sp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_label_text_size_landscape">10sp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Action buttons -->
    <dimen name="hud_action_btn_size_landscape">56dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_action_btn_margin_end_landscape">10dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_action_btn_padding_landscape">12dp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Angle gauge (landscape motorcycle) -->
    <dimen name="hud_angle_gauge_width_landscape">110dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_angle_block_width_landscape">120dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_angle_margin_start_landscape">4dp</dimen>
    
    <!-- Speed display -->
    <dimen name="hud_speed_width_landscape">88dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="hud_trip_gap_landscape">24dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="map_controls_margin_top_landscape">90dp</dimen>
    <!-- Mapbox camera padding (landscape) -->
    <dimen name="mapbox_overview_padding_top">24dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_overview_padding_left">24dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_overview_padding_bottom">120dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_overview_padding_right">24dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_following_padding_top">64dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_following_padding_left">24dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_following_padding_bottom">140dp</dimen>
    <dimen name="mapbox_following_padding_right">24dp</dimen>
</resources>
